title: Automated eDNA Extraction from Estuarine Samples Using Magnetic Beads
author: Fouad El Baidouri

steps.title: Prepare work area
steps.instruction: Work in a biosafety cabinet under aseptic conditions and gather all reagents, tubes, pipettes, and the KingFisher instrument.

steps.title: Process wet filters
steps.instruction: For each wet filter, pipette all Longmire's buffer from the sample tube into a separate Eppendorf tube (leave the filter in the tube), then add 490 µL of the original Longmire's buffer back to the sample tube, add 10 µL Proteinase K per filter (total volume 500 µL), mix thoroughly with the pipette tip, and ensure the filter is completely submerged in the buffer‑Proteinase K solution.

steps.title: Process dry filters
steps.instruction: For each dry filter, add 1000 µL Longmire's solution to the tube, ensuring the filter is fully submerged, then incubate at 56 °C for 90 minutes or overnight (or store at 4 °C for later extraction). After incubation, repeat the wet‑filter steps: remove all buffer, add 490 µL original buffer, add 10 µL Proteinase K, mix, and keep the filter submerged.

steps.title: Incubate with rotation
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in a rack on a rotating or gently shaking surface inside a 56 °C incubator, secure the rack with tape, turn on the rotator, and incubate for 90 minutes or overnight.

steps.title: Transfer lysate and add beads
steps.instruction: After incubation, transfer 400 µL of the supernatant lysate to a new deep‑well plate (sample plate). Seal tubes tightly to prevent evaporation (bubbles may form due to SDS). Add 320 µL Illumina Tune beads to each well (1 : 8 sample‑to‑beads ratio) to bind DNA and remove fragments <200 bp.

steps.title: Prepare wash and elution plates
steps.instruction: During the 90‑minute incubation, pipette 500 µL freshly prepared 80 % ethanol into each well of two wash plates (DWPs). Also pipette 100 µL of 10 mM Tris‑HCl into each well of a 200 µL elution plate.

steps.title: Run KingFisher program
steps.instruction: Load the sample plate (now containing ~720 µL sample + beads), the two wash plates, and the elution plate into the KingFisher instrument and execute the following program:

substeps.instruction: 2. Binding: mix for 5 min at medium speed; collect beads (count = 5); move to sample plate.
3. 1st Wash: release beads; bottom mix 10 s and medium speed 10 s, loop 2×; collect beads (count = 3, collect time = 5 s); transfer to wash plate 1.
4. 2nd Wash: release beads for 20 s; bottom mix 10 s and medium speed 10 s, loop 2×; collect beads (count = 4, collect time = 5 s); transfer to wash plate 2.
6. Elution: preheat to 60 °C; bottom mix 15 s, medium speed 45 s, loop 6×; collect beads (count = 1); transfer to elution plate.
7. Collection of beads: 2 min at slow speed.

steps.title: Post‑run cleanup or storage
steps.instruction: Immediately after the KingFisher program, either proceed with Zymo cleanup steps using the elution plate or store the plate at –20 °C for future use. Dispose of all chemical reagents according to the Lab Hazardous Waste Management Plan.
